cards.name: Charmelia Deal

coverage_override.reason: Fresh semantic segmentation found 3 individual printed procedure/effect records. Conjunctions, choices, dependent 'then/and if you do' steps, and their HOPT/use-cap text are kept with the single Lua effect that resolves them; separately functioning procedures, continuous rules, and activated/triggered effects are separate records.

effects.printed_clause: When activated: optionally add 1 "Charmelia" Ritual Monster and/or 1 "Charmelia" Ritual Spell from Deck; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation count uses id; resolution selects a subgroup of one or two where at most one is a Ritual Monster and at most one is an eligible Ritual Spell, then adds/confirms them.

official_references.matched_structure: Optional search performed when a persistent Spell is activated.
Ritual Spell search and Deck-to-hand confirmation.

effects.printed_clause: All "Charmelia" monsters you control gain 400 ATK/DEF.
effects.lua_implementation: Paired field EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK/DEFENSE effects target face-up Charmelia monsters in the controller's Monster Zone and apply +400.

official_references.matched_structure: Paired archetype-wide field ATK/DEF updates on a persistent Spell.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to the GY by the effect of a "Charmelia" monster: place this card face-up in your S/T Zone; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger still requires REASON_EFFECT and a Charmelia handler, but now identifies the causing effect as a monster effect with re:IsActiveType(TYPE_MONSTER) before moving this card face-up from GY.

official_references.matched_structure: EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger that later places a qualifying Continuous Spell/Trap face-up with MoveToField.
Uses re:IsActiveType/trigger semantics for identifying the type of the effect that caused a movement event.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the old condition inspected the handler's current type after movement/state changes. It now tests the active type captured for the effect that actually sent this card.

cards.reconciliation_note: All batch_8c findings for this card were re-evaluated against current Lua and the cited official Omega references. Confirmed defects are patched; retained CUSTOM_GAP records explain the remaining engine/source limit.
